in_hebrew.name: Helaine
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Helaine הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'helios', meaning sun. The name Helaine is a beautiful variation of Helen, which also stems from the Greek word for 'sun'. This name is perfect for a child born during the bright and sunny days of summer.
